clips.title: The story
paras: Above Ironforge’s Great Forge, Nissa Firestone teaches field medicine to travelers and soldiers.

Nissa Firestone tends patients on the upper floor of the Ironforge Physician shop. The Great Forge’s clang and heat rise around her, but the work is keeping wounds bound. Dwarven warriors can endure much, yet blades and claws still break their skin. Before travelers and soldiers head into the snows of Dun Morogh or farther afield, Nissa teaches them basic bandaging and field dressings to help keep themselves and their allies alive.

Nissa Firestone teaches field medics the basics of cloth and lint. When a practitioner has learned all she can teach, she points them toward specialized triage officers in far-flung outposts. Skilled healers go where the Alliance’s casualties are heaviest.
